name: Remove every mention of Umbra
body: Dean, 2026-10-30: there shouldn't be any mention of Umbra in lantern.

comments.text: Done. Comments, README, brief (Umbra sections removed, M0 is now the design record), architecture (mapping table removed), decisions and kanban bodies reworded; docs/umbra-audit.md deleted. What remains is library names from other repositories (Umbra::IWidget, Umbra::IViewportRenderer, Umbra::ChaosPropDiff from umbra-interfaces, Chaos's ChaosBuildTarget::UmbraEngine, chaos's libs/umbra-interfaces path in nyx-sys/build.rs) and this card.

plan:
- Code comments in crates/ and games/platformer: describe what the code does without the comparison.
- README, brief, architecture (drop the mapping table), decisions and kanban bodies: reword.
- Delete docs/umbra-audit.md.
- Names from other repositories stay, because lantern can't rename them: umbra-interfaces' Umbra::IWidget and Umbra::IViewportRenderer, and Chaos's UmbraEngine build target. Each is used in one or two files.
